cities.name: Pan-India National Highway Network (36 Major Hubs)
cities.description: Comprehensive nationwide logistics network spanning Golden Quadrilateral, North-South (NH44), East-West (NH27), and Coastal (NH66) Corridors across 36 major Indian freight hubs.

cities.name: North India Regional Corridor (UP, Rajasthan, Punjab & Haryana - 14 Hubs)
cities.description: Northern freight corridor connecting Uttar Pradesh (Lucknow, Kanpur, Agra, Varanasi, Meerut, Prayagraj), Rajasthan (Jaipur, Jodhpur, Udaipur, Kota), and Punjab/Haryana (Ludhiana, Amritsar, Chandigarh, Faridabad).

cities.name: South India Regional Corridor (Kerala, TN, AP & Karnataka - 13 Hubs)
cities.description: Southern multimodal corridor spanning Kerala (Kochi, Thiruvananthapuram, Kozhikode), Tamil Nadu (Coimbatore, Madurai, Tiruchirappalli, Salem), Andhra Pradesh (Visakhapatnam, Vijayawada, Guntur), and Karnataka (Mysuru, Hubballi-Dharwad, Mangaluru).

cities.name: West & Central India Corridor (Gujarat, Maharashtra, MP & Chhattisgarh - 12 Hubs)
cities.description: Western & Central industrial network linking Gujarat (Surat, Vadodara, Rajkot), Maharashtra (Nagpur, Nashik, Aurangabad), Madhya Pradesh (Indore, Bhopal, Jabalpur, Gwalior), and Chhattisgarh (Raipur, Bhilai).

cities.name: East & Northeast Corridor (Bihar, Odisha, Jharkhand, WB & Assam - 11 Hubs)
cities.description: Eastern trade and Northeast gateway linking Bihar (Patna, Gaya), Odisha (Bhubaneswar, Cuttack), Jharkhand (Ranchi, Jamshedpur, Dhanbad), West Bengal (Asansol, Siliguri, Durgapur), and Assam (Guwahati).

cities.name: Mumbai Metropolitan Region (MMR)
cities.description: High-density coastal metropolis including BKC, Nariman Point, Andheri MIDC, Thane, Vashi, and JNPT Port.

cities.name: Delhi NCR Metropolitan Hub
cities.description: Capital region network connecting Connaught Place, Cyber Hub Gurugram, Noida Sector 62, Okhla, and Aerocity.

cities.name: Bengaluru Silicon Corridor
cities.description: Tech capital road network spanning Majestic, Koramangala, Indiranagar, Electronic City, and Whitefield.

cities.name: Chennai Metropolitan & Port Grid
cities.description: Automotive and port logistics network covering Chennai Port, Guindy, OMR IT Corridor, and Sriperumbudur SEZ.

cities.name: Hyderabad Cyberabad Corridor
cities.description: HITEC City, Gachibowli Financial District, Secunderabad, and Shamshabad Airport logistics corridor.

cities.name: Kolkata Metropolitan Network
cities.description: Howrah Freight Terminal, Salt Lake Sector V, New Town, Burrabazar, and Dankuni Multi-Modal Terminal.

cities.name: Pune Industrial & Auto Corridor
cities.description: Shivajinagar, Hinjawadi IT Park, Chakan MIDC Auto Hub, Hadapsar, and Bhosari Industrial Estate.

cities.name: Ahmedabad-Gandhinagar Corridor
cities.description: Kalupur Depot, SG Highway, Sanand Auto Hub, Naroda GIDC, and GIFT City Infocity.

cities.name: India Smart Grid Synthetic City (Dholera SIR 25 Zones)
cities.description: Flagship Indian Greenfield Smart Industrial City Grid (Dholera SIR, Gujarat) modeled with 25 interconnected smart logistics sectors, arterial avenues, and automated freight corridors.
